sched: Every other weekend; check the Miami event page for current dates and locations.

sched: Free weekly run clubs across South Florida; see the official location directory for the current Miami schedule and meeting points.

note: Miami's monthly mass bike ride — 12–18 miles at 12–14 mph through the city, rain or shine. Not a protest, just the biggest rolling social event on two wheels.
know: A large, social group ride held on the last Friday of each month; meet at 6:30 PM and expect the ride to depart at 7:15 PM.
